name: Velinde's Key
summary: In Darnassus, Thyn'tel Bladeweaver keeps Velinde's Key for those who seek the vanished priestess's fate. It guards her writings and belongings.

sections.title: A Trusted Token
sections.body: Thyn'tel Bladeweaver keeps Velinde's Key in Darnassus. The simple key opens a footlocker holding Priestess Velinde Starsong's personal belongings. It rests in the Sentinel bunkhouse above the Tradesmen's Terrace. Velinde left night elf lands without warning, so her possessions were set aside. Bladeweaver lends the key only to those who bring genuine proof of their interest in her fate, such as revelations from the Tome of Mel'Thandris.

sections.title: Unlocking the Past
sections.body: Velinde Starsong's key opens her storage chest, where her journal records her duties and troubled thoughts. The Sentinels long believed she left for personal matters and would someday return. Her writings begin to uncover a darker mystery around the expedition that took her away.

aliases: where do i use velinde's key
faq.answer: Velinde's Key opens Velinde's Locker, a chest in the Sentinel bunkhouse in Darnassus. It is on the upper floor, across a bridge in the Tradesmen's Terrace.
Thyn'tel Bladeweaver, a Sentinel in Darnassus, entrusts you with the key as you investigate Velinde's disappearance.
Velinde Starsong was a respected night elf priestess trusted by the Sentinels. She left suddenly on her own business and left her belongings behind in Darnassus.

faq.q: What is found inside her locked chest?
faq.answer: Velinde's Journal rests inside the locker. It records her duties and sheds light on what compelled her to leave night elf lands.

angles.text: As a night elf, you handle the belongings of a respected priestess whose loyalty to Elune and her people was beyond question.
As a priest, you follow the traces of a devoted sister of Elune whose path took a solitary and troubling turn.
